footerTagline: Sakha futhi sixhumanise abantu sibeka ubumfihlo nokuphepha phambili.
heroDescription: Sakha izinhlelo zokusebenza ze-Android ezicatshangelwe kahle futhi sihlola imibono yesizukulwane esisha kubuhlakani bokwenziwa, ubumfihlo nokuphepha ukuze sakhe ubuchwepheshe obubeka abantu kuqala.
journeyTitle: Idatha yakho. Ukukhetha kwakho. Ukulawula kwakho.
journeyIntro: Ukubuka okulula kwezingozi zobumfihlo abantu abangahlangabezana nazo ku-inthanethi kanye nendlela egxile kubumfihlo esiyihlola ne-SafeMobile.
journeyStep1Text: Uma usebenzisa uhlelo lokusebenza noma isevisi, ulwazi lungadlula kumanethiwekhi nasezinsizeni ezahlukene.
journeyStep2Text: Ama-tracker ezinkampani zangaphandle nobuchwepheshe bokwenza amaphrofayela bangabheka umsebenzi kuzo zonke izinhlelo zokusebenza namawebhusayithi.
journeyStep3Text: Sicwaninga ulwazi lwe-SafeMobile olungasiza ekuboneni nasekumiseni umsebenzi osolisayo. Alukakakhishwa.
journeyStep4Text: Izinketho ezicacile, izilungiselelo ezizenzakalelayo ezihlonipha ubumfihlo nezilawuli ezisobala kufanele zinike abantu amandla okwenza izinqumo zabo.
journeyFootnote: Uhambo lobumfihlo oluyisibonelo; aluchazi isici sokuvikela se-SafeMobile esikhona njengamanje.
aboutDescription: Sakha imikhiqizo yedijithali ewusizo futhi sihlola ubuchwepheshe obunomthwalo wemfanelo, sinikeza abantu amathuluzi abawadingayo sigxile kubumfihlo nokuphepha.
productsDescription: Iqoqo elikhulayo lamathuluzi edijithali aklanywe ngokucophelela, kusukela kumathuluzi ansuku zonke e-Android kuya ezinhlelweni zocwaningo lobumfihlo nokuphepha.
safeTitle: Okuhlangenwe nakho kweselula okuphephile kakhudlwana, okuklanywe kugxile kubumfihlo.
safeDescription: I-SafeMobile iwuhlelo lwethu locwaningo oluhlola okuhlangenwe nakho kokuphepha kwe-Android okuhlonipha ubumfihlo. Sicwaninga ngolwazi lwezingozi zedivayisi, ukuqwashisa ngokuphepha kwezimali nobuhlakani obusebenza kudivayisi uqobo.
contactDescription: Unemibuzo mayelana nezinhlelo zethu, ucwaningo noma inkampani? Sithumele umlayezo. Siyajabula ukuzwa kuwe.
notFoundDescription: Ikhasi olifunayo kungenzeka lithuthelwe kwenye indawo noma alisatholakali.
researchDescription: Sihlola ukuthi amasistimu ahlakaniphile nobunjiniyela obuhlonipha ubumfihlo kungadala kanjani okuhlangenwe nakho kwedijithali okuphephile nokuwusizo kakhudlwana.
quizIntro: Khetha okufunayo ukukwenza bese sizokukhombisa uhlelo olufanele.
quizResultPdf: I-VibeSync All in ONE PDF Suite iyindawo enhle yokuqala.
quizResultDeveloper: I-Developer Options Shortcut inikeza ukufinyelela okusheshayo ku-Android Developer Options.
quizResultKids: I-Kids Drawing Studio inikeza izingane indawo ejabulisayo yokudweba.
quizHint: Khetha inketho eyodwa ukuze uthole isincomo.
heroImageAlt: Ozakwethu basebenzisana bezungeze itafula endaweni yokusebenza yesimanje ekhanyayo
